children: According to ChainCatcher citing Mlm onchain, trader Aguilatrades has earned about $9 million from BTC trades since opening this round on Nov. 1, after depositing $1.17 million. Over nearly three weeks, his BTC trading volume reached $5.25 billion, and he paid $1.22 million in fees, about 2% of all fees on Hyperliquid during the period. He closed 64 trades with a win rate of about 40% and currently holds a short position of about 1,500 BTC. Despite the gains, his cumulative losses on Hyperliquid remain about $29 million. In summer 2025, he lost nearly $40 million trading BTC and ETH.

title: Aguilatrades Earns $9M From BTC Trades, Holds 1,500 BTC Short
